description: RF protocol analysis and reverse engineering: rtl_433 (ISM band), multimon-ng (multi-protocol), inspectrum (spectrogram), URH (Universal Radio Hacker), and ubertooth (Bluetooth).
notes:
Lightweight protocol analysis workspace for ISM band, Bluetooth, and RF reverse engineering. Includes GNU Radio 3.10 + OOT modules in the base.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.
